notes.subject: mafelo a go fula
notes.rationale: מגרש ke naga ya go fula yeo e sa alogago le toropong — 'mafelo a go fula' e beile seswantšho, e sego 'boagedi'

notes.subject: lenaneo la metse
notes.rationale: Temana ye ke karolo ya lenaneo la metse ya Balefi — go balelwa metse le mafelo a yona

translation: Gomme go tšwa go setšhaba sa Gade, ⟨את⟩ Ramaote ya go Gilagade le ⟨את⟩ mafelo a yona a go fula, le ⟨את⟩ Makhanaime le ⟨את⟩ mafelo a yona a go fula.
